source_scope.source_detail_limit: The locked ODS material mixes vendor snapshots, examples and ingestion code. Source fields are comparison evidence only; canonical versions, graph direction, security boundaries and runtime observations are governed independently.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Every authoritative metadata asset has a reviewed grain, decision, canonical target, unique SoR, field boundaries, history/delete/backfill policy, corrections and implementation references.
verification_policy.verified_definition: An asset is verified only after a non-empty tenant-scoped runtime reconciliation supplies a durable evidence reference, positive row and tenant counts, and a terminal verified status.

assets.source_grain: one vendor scheduler observation of one source task-run attempt at one observation time; the source row is not a stable final run record
canonical_targets: latest observation projection and runtime aggregate
assets.sor_owner: the external scheduler owns execution; cloudmold-metadata owns normalized append-only observations and their exact Task-version link

field_rules.tenant: resolve an explicit positive tenant_id before ingestion and require the referenced Task version in the same tenant; project id is not a tenant
field_rules.business_key: qualify source instance_id by tenant, source system and environment; attempt plus observation_sequence is immutable and replay-stable
field_rules.time: parse each documented epoch or calendar field explicitly into UTC instants; never guess between milliseconds, seconds and yyyymmdd, and keep scheduled/started/finished/observed times distinct
field_rules.status: map a versioned scheduler status dictionary to monotonic observations; a failure-only polling script cannot prove a complete run population
field_rules.value_or_unit: duration/resource/row counts are nonnegative integers; compute cost is exact minor units plus ISO-4217 currency, never the source floating budget
field_rules.security_boundary: raw sql_content, param_values, web_url, connection and error text are forbidden; retain only hashes or restricted opaque checkpoint/output/error references

assets.history_policy: append every observation sequence and derive current state by the greatest valid sequence; never overwrite retries or terminal evidence
assets.delete_policy: a source disappearance or partition overwrite cannot delete run history; record a source-correction observation only with explicit evidence
assets.backfill_policy: backfill by qualified run, attempt and observation time, deduplicate stable payload hashes, quarantine ambiguous timestamps/statuses and reconcile counts per tenant/task/day
corrections: correct the documented begin_wait_time versus ingestion begin_wait_time_time mismatch
separate scheduler execution truth from metadata observation truth
replace raw SQL/errors/URLs and floating budget with restricted references and exact minor-unit cost
reject failure-only API extraction as evidence of all task runs
